title: UNVERIFIED — The Ostinato, Elongated

features.name: an ostinato, eleven notes
features.desc-on-touch: He has stopped humming without stopping the movement of his fingers. A loose part of the window plays descending bass notes whenever the train crosses a join, and now the two cannot be separated.

features.name: a declivity of meadow
features.desc-on-touch: Not a basement but a lower part of a field, where you might sit and watch the evening star dust off the learnings of the underworld on its return journey.

features.name: a jetpack, being serviced
features.desc-on-touch: Fuel tank aligned, nitrogen regulator distributing to the rocket nozzle, catalyst bed tight against the belly strap. Beside it a skirt, a flat mirrorball, perhaps used as a thermal blanket as the dew settles.

features.name: Come in Spinner
features.desc-on-touch: Before reading it on the beach one Summer, he thought the spinner was a World War Two fighter plane coming in to land.

inscription: like walking down into a basement, whenever we cross a join
